details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- prompts/mode-plan.txt:143 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new single-line "- Missing scope: ..." rule (also in prompts/_templates/mode-plan.txt line 136) makes the rendered DEFAULT-tier planner prompt 251 lines, over the 250-line limit that tests/prompt_size_budget.py enforces.
  WHY: The required check "quick / static-checks" fails on head 99c7965b with "FAIL: .../prompts/mode-plan.txt: 251 lines exceeds DEFAULT limit of 250" and exits 1, so the PR cannot merge; all three reviewers rated it BLOCKER.
- scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:12-13, 179-202, 297 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The planner that plan.yml actually runs (lines 2195/2198) builds its prompt from the inline heredoc in run_plan_codex.sh and never sees the new `SCOPE_MISSING:` rule, which went only into prompts/mode-plan.txt and its template.
  WHY: The planner never emits SCOPE_MISSING lines, so plan_scope_block_route.sh always logs `reason=no_scope_lines` and Goal 3 (routing to override_guard) never fires in production; the tests use hand-written fixtures, which hides this. run_plan_codex.sh is not in the issue's files_touched grant.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:1157-1173 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In the override_guard has_plan=true branch, `_approve(item, ctx["labels"], guard_label)` (with `_approve` at lines 844-851) posts `/approved` and removes only ai:scope-blocked, so ai:blocked, which plan.yml added alongside it, stays on the issue.
  WHY: On a re-plan, has_plan is true because unblock_judge.sh lines 2063-2067 match any older plan comment, so the issue resumes from the older plan; the leftover ai:blocked then resolves to stop=blocked on the next scan and the issue resumes a second time. test_scope_override_with_a_plan_keeps_todays_ops locks this behaviour in. Three reviewers rated it MAJOR; minimax gave no severity.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:1157-1176 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new no-plan reset branch (`/reclarify`, stop-label removal and ai:blocked removal) applies to every stop in GUARD_STOPS, so a destructive-blocked issue without a plan now goes back to clarification instead of through `_approve` (`/approved` and ai:awaiting-approval).
  WHY: This is an undocumented, backward-incompatible change to existing override_guard grants that the issue, the changelog and the PR description never mention. Severities disagree: gemini rated it MAJOR, luna and glm rated it NIT, minimax gave none; the highest is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 considered and dropped this finding because destructive-blocked arises only at implement time, when has_plan is in practice always true.
- scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh:95-124 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: SCOPE_PATH_RE (`\S+`, line 95) and clean() (lines 106-124) accept backtick-wrapped paths such as "SCOPE_MISSING: `tests/test_x.py`" and keep the backticks, because clean() rejects only "*?[]{}", backslash and characters outside printable ASCII.
  WHY: Neither files_touched_scope_guard.normalize_path nor unblock_ledger._clean_path strips backticks, so the grant writes the literal backticked string into files_touched. That entry never matches the real file, and planning or implementation stops again on the same path after a "successful" grant. The prompt itself shows the format wrapped in backticks.
- scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh:95-163 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The router routes whenever valid SCOPE_MISSING lines exist and never checks that missing scope is the only reason in the `BLOCKED:` line.
  WHY: Output such as "BLOCKED: a private credential is required" plus a SCOPE_MISSING line is still routed to ai:scope-blocked and offered override_guard, so the issue resumes while the real blocker still stands, contrary to Goal 4 ("Any other planning block behaves exactly as today"). Severities disagree: gemini and luna rated it MAJOR, glm rated it NIT, minimax gave none; the highest is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 considered and dropped this finding because the prompt contract governs it and the judge still validates the paths.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:2645-2647 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `ensure_label_exists "ai:scope-blocked"` caches per `repo|label` (scripts/label_helpers.sh lines 182-217, cache key at line 193), so it never reuses the ai:blocked entry and runs its own `gh label create` (line 202) on every routed block.
  WHY: The extra API call contradicts the "No new API calls" claims in README.md, changelog.d/9534-judge-scope-gaps.md, agents.d/9534-judge-scope-gaps.md and the step comment, and the issue's §15 constraint. Severities disagree: gemini rated it MAJOR, sonnet, luna and glm rated it NIT, minimax gave none; the highest is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10814-10817 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: An empty `files_touched:` block is treated as no_block, so the helper returns the body unchanged instead of adding the three missing companions.
  WHY: A judge-created issue with an empty files_touched block does not receive tests/**, changelog.d/* or agents.d/*, although the requirement covers any body that has a files_touched block.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The planner prompt (`prompts/_templates/mode-plan.txt`, plus its rendered copy) gets one rule: when the only blocker is that needed files are outside `files_touched`, emit the `BLOCKED:` line and then one `SCOPE_MISSING: <repo-relative path>` line per file." (Goal 3)
  expected_change_site: scripts/run_plan_codex.sh, the inline planner prompt heredoc (PROMPT_TEMPLATE_FILE, lines 13-285, rendered at line 297), next to the BLOCKED / WAITING rules at lines 179-202
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: no diff hunk touches scripts/run_plan_codex.sh, which plan.yml lines 2195/2198 run and which renders only its inline heredoc (line 297), never prompts/mode-plan.txt; the PR changes only prompts/_templates/mode-plan.txt (line 136) and prompts/mode-plan.txt (line 143); `rg -n SCOPE_MISSING scripts/run_plan_codex.sh` returns no matches; the heredoc's BLOCKED rule block (lines 179-202) mirrors mode-plan.txt, including the "Sequencing wait" rule, but has no Missing-scope rule, so Goal 3 is inert end to end
- requirement: "Existing guards: tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py, tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py and `make generate-check` pass" / Phase 1 done-check "the tests below pass" (the rendered prompt must stay within the 250-line limit that tests/prompt_size_budget.py enforces)
  expected_change_site: prompts/mode-plan.txt and prompts/_templates/mode-plan.txt (line 143 / 136)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: "quick / static-checks" fails on PR head 99c7965b (run 45095033320, job 137432853915) with "FAIL: .../prompts/mode-plan.txt: 251 lines exceeds DEFAULT limit of 250", `make generate-check` fails for the same reason, the PR's Acceptance table lists tests/test_plan_clarify_blocked_output.py as "unmet" and tests/test_unblock_judge.py, tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py and tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py as "not run", and no hunk keeps the rendered prompt within budget (suggested fix: fold the rule into the adjacent "Sequencing wait" bullet in both files)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- prompts/mode-plan.txt (also prompts/_templates/mode-plan.txt):143 (template line 136) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The added "- Missing scope: ..." line makes the rendered DEFAULT-tier prompt 251 lines; tests/prompt_size_budget.py allows at most 250.
  WHY: "quick / static-checks" fails on head 99c7965b ("251 lines exceeds DEFAULT limit of 250") and exits 1. Fix: fold the rule into the "Sequencing wait" bullet on line 142 in both files; do not raise the budget.
- scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:12-13, 179-202, 297 (.github/workflows/plan.yml lines 2195/2198) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The planner the workflow runs never sees the `SCOPE_MISSING:` rule, because run_plan_codex.sh renders an inline heredoc and never inlines mode-plan.txt (line 246 mentions it only for the Q-ID format). tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py lines 1104-1108 keep rules in step across all three files.
  WHY: The planner never emits SCOPE_MISSING, so plan_scope_block_route.sh logs `reason=no_scope_lines` and Goal 3 never fires; the fixture-based tests hide this. run_plan_codex.sh is outside the files_touched grant.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:1161-1162 (`_approve` at 844-851) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: For a routed planning scope block, the has_plan=true branch still posts `/approved` and removes only ai:scope-blocked; unblock_judge.sh lines 2063-2067 set has_plan=true whenever any older trusted plan exists, the normal case for a re-plan.
  WHY: Implementation starts from the older plan, and ai:blocked (added at plan.yml lines 2652-2654) stays, so the next scan finds stop=blocked and resumes the issue a second time. Fix: take /reclarify for planning-header scope blocks, or at least remove ai:blocked after `_approve`.
- scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh:~95, ~106-124 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: SCOPE_PATH_RE and clean() accept backtick-wrapped paths and keep the backticks; normalize_path (lines 264-269) strips only whitespace and "./".
  WHY: The already_in_scope check misses, and the grant writes the literal backticked string into files_touched, so the scope stop repeats on the same path. Fix: reject backticks and quotes in clean(), or strip one surrounding pair.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:2645-2647 (scripts/label_helpers.sh 182-217, line 202) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The per-label cache means ai:scope-blocked never reuses the ai:blocked entry, so each routed block makes one extra `gh label create` call.
  WHY: This is functionally harmless, but README.md, the changelog and the step comment say "no extra API call". Fix the wording, or skip the call when ISSUE_META_FILE already lists the label.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: the planner prompt "gets one rule" to emit `BLOCKED:` and then one `SCOPE_MISSING:` line per file (Goal 3) | Expected change site: scripts/run_plan_codex.sh inline heredoc (lines 13-285), beside the rules at lines 179-202 | Evidence of absence: no hunk touches run_plan_codex.sh, which renders only its heredoc (line 297) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Existing guards ... and `make generate-check` pass" / "the tests below pass" | Expected change site: prompts/mode-plan.txt and prompts/_templates/mode-plan.txt (250-line budget) | Evidence of absence: static-checks fails at 251 lines; the Acceptance table lists test_plan_clarify_blocked_output.py as "unmet" and test_unblock_judge.py, test_orchestrate_poll_process.py and test_workflow_file_size_limit.py as "not run" | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (3 related items, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3): reject backticks and quotes in clean()
